about_the_game:
Enjoy the numerous diverse, alien tracks of Fourmiworld & beyond in this multi-disc, 28-track album - including a special six-song remix EP built right in!

Featuring a guest-composed track by Chuck Salamone of Hylics 2 & Flips¿de - Altared State!

From the strange & experimental songs of Wandereye's favorite artists, to the ambient, inter-dimensional concertos of Dimension: Planck, this comprehensive soundtrack has everything your ears & antennas could ever need - now in remastered, lossless quality!

Just shy of an hour and a half of music, every song from the game is included!

What's more, you'll also get access to extra content, such as:

  • Extended trailer music

  • A never-before-heard bonus track

  • And SIX all new remix tracks!
